SkillSpokeEvent.description: Standard event envelope for all user, domain, data, and system events in the SkillSpoke platform.

eventId.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance (e.g., ULID).

eventType.description: Logical type of the event, following the pattern 'domain.entity.verb' (e.g., 'job-search.execution.finished').

eventSchemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the event payload schema (not the envelope schema).

category.description: One of the four categories, chosen by the producer for each event.

domain.description: Primary domain to which this event belongs (e.g., job-search, candidate-profile, billing).

tags.description: Free-form labels for experimentation, rollout cohorts, or other non-structural classification.

Source.description: Information about the service that produced the event.

service.description: Logical name of the producing service.

subsystem.description: Optional subsystem or component name within the service.

region.description: Region in which the event was produced.

environment.description: Deployment environment where the event originated.

Timestamps.description: Key timestamps for when the event occurred and was published.

occurredAt.description: When the underlying business or system action logically occurred.

publishedAt.description: When the event was published to the event bus.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration time for this event in the context of retries or workflow validity.

Trace.description: Identifiers that link this event to a broader workflow or distributed trace.

correlationId.description: Business-level identifier for the overall unit of work or saga that this event is part of.

causationId.description: Identifier of the prior event that directly caused this event, if any.

parentEventId.description: Identifier of a parent event in a fan-out or tree structure, if applicable.

rootEventId.description: Identifier of the first event in the overall workflow.

traceId.description: Distributed tracing identifier (e.g., W3C trace ID, X-Ray trace ID).

spanId.description: Span identifier within the distributed trace.

Actor.description: Information about the actor responsible for initiating the event, if applicable.

actorType.description: Type of actor initiating the event.

actorId.description: Identifier of the actor (user ID, system ID, etc.).

Identifiers.description: Canonical identifiers for joining events with domain data (tenant, user, resource, etc.).

userId.description: Primary user identifier relevant to this event.

executionId.description: Identifier for the logical execution or workflow instance represented by this event.

resourceType.description: Type of the primary resource associated with this event.

resourceId.description: Identifier of the primary resource associated with this event.

parentResourceId.description: Identifier of a parent resource, if applicable.

BusinessContext.description: High-level business process and step information for this event.

Lifecycle.description: State, outcome, severity, and error details for this event.

phase.description: High-level phase of the lifecycle at the time of this event.

outcome.description: Outcome of the action represented by this event.

severity.description: Severity level for the outcome of this event.

statusCode.description: Domain-specific or HTTP-like status code representing the outcome.

statusSummary.description: Short, human-readable summary of the outcome.

statusReason.description: Optional additional detail regarding the status.

isError.description: Convenience flag indicating whether this event represents an error condition.

Retry.description: Information about retries associated with this event. The policy structure is intentionally flexible to support complex strategies.

retryCount.description: Number of attempts that have been made so far for this logical operation.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries allowed under the current policy, if applicable.

isFinalAttempt.description: Indicates whether this attempt is the final one according to the current policy.

nextRetryAt.description: Planned time for the next retry attempt, if any.

retryStrategy.description: High-level name of the retry strategy in use (e.g., exponential-backoff).

retryReason.description: Free-text explanation of why a retry is being attempted or scheduled.

firstAttemptAt.description: Timestamp of the first attempt in this series.

policy.description: Optional structured description of the retry policy. The exact shape is defined by the retry subsystem.

LifecycleDetails.description: Additional details about errors, performance, and SLAs related to this event.

errorCategory.description: High-level classification of the error type, if any.

errorDetails.description: Optional structured data with additional error information.

errorSource.description: Name of the component or service where the error originated.

logReference.description: Identifier or URI that can be used to locate detailed logs or traces for this event.

remediationHint.description: Optional human-readable hint for how to fix or investigate the problem.

isTransient.description: Indicates whether the error is considered transient and potentially recoverable with retries.

durationMs.description: Duration of the operation represented by this event, in milliseconds, if applicable.

slaMs.description: Target SLA for the operation, in milliseconds, if applicable.

sloViolated.description: Indicates whether the operation violated an SLO or SLA objective.

Visibility.description: Classification and privacy-related metadata for this event.

classification.description: Data classification level for this event.

piiPresent.description: Indicates whether the payload contains personally identifiable information.

Payload.description: Domain-specific information carried by the event, either inline or via an external reference (coat-check pattern).

mode.description: Whether the payload is included inline or referenced externally.

schemaUri.description: URI pointing to the schema that describes the payload contents.

contentType.description: MIME type for the payload contents.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the payload content in bytes, if known.

inline.description: Inline domain-specific content. Present when mode is 'inline'.

PayloadReference.description: External reference to the payload content. Present when mode is 'reference'.

storageType.description: Type of external storage where the payload is stored.

location.description: URI or address of the externally stored payload.

checksum.description: Checksum of the stored payload for integrity verification.

encrypted.description: Indicates whether the stored payload is encrypted.
